root_cause.text: Off-by-one loop condition in `nvme_dbbuf_set` uses `i <= dev->online_queues`, causing access to index `dev->online_queues` which is beyond the allocated queue array (valid indices are 0 to `dev->online_queues - 1`).
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes the loop from `for (i = 1; i <= dev->online_queues; i++)` to `for (i = 1; i < dev->online_queues; i++)`. The commit message explicitly states: "dev->online_queues is a count incremented in nvme_init_queue. Thus, valid indices are 0 through dev->online_queues − 1." The KASAN splat confirms a slab-out-of-bounds read at `nvme_dbbuf_free` called from `nvme_dbbuf_set`.
